title: HustleBox v1.2.5 — The Back Room Opens
message:
Ray told you to stay out. You're going anyway.

THE BACK ROOM
The Arcade tab is now called the Back Room — single name everywhere. It's a CSS-rendered scene of a dingy basement: hanging lightbulb that sways overhead, peeling wallpaper texture, cracked window with neon leaking in, Ray's note pinned to the wall warning you off. Four tappable objects in the room:
• 🪙 Coin Flip — pick heads or tails, double or nothing
• 🎰 Slot Machine — three reels, pair = 2x, jackpot (three matching) = 10x
• 🃏 Scratch Card — buy a card, reveal 9 squares, three matching icons win (diamonds pay 10x)
• 🎲 Dice — bet over/under 7 for 2x, or exact 7 for 5x

All four are playable. Bets start at 10 Stacks. Tap Ray's note for a special message.

NEW ACHIEVEMENTS
• 5 Back Room achievements (Ray Said Don't, House Bleeds, Jackpot, Lucky Seven, Three Diamonds)
• 2 secret achievements (Whale: win 1000+ in one play, Ray Was Right: lose everything)

CUSTOMER VOICES — 35+ NEW PHRASINGS
The voice lines are way more varied now. Polite customers, gruff customers, in-a-rush customers, hungry customers, indecisive customers. Plus item-specific commentary — burger fans, pizza fans, Tuesday taco people, salad eaters trying to eat clean.

QR CODE IS A POP-UP NOW
Friends → Show QR now opens a centered modal with the QR code big, easy to scan with a phone camera. Tap outside or the X to close.

WALKING MARCUS REDESIGN
The end-of-shift cinematic now shows a full side-profile Marcus with animated arms and legs — proper walking cycle, opposing limb swing, head bob. Not just a floating head with a cap anymore.

PROFILE → RESUME LAYOUT
Profile is now structured like a resume: hero card up top, career timeline as the main section (dots connecting Dishwasher → Owner with 'YOU ARE HERE' marker on your current rank), story quote, stats grid, trophy count footer.

DESKTOP LAYOUT FIXES
• Mouse scroll wheel now works on desktop. The bug was scroll-lock being applied during gameplay regardless of platform — on desktop with a fixed sidebar, that blocked all page scroll. Now scroll-lock is mobile-only.
• Content has a max width on desktop so text doesn't stretch across a 4K monitor. Cards are contained, achievements display in 2 columns, profile hero is bigger.

No save data wiped.
